svg.title: CoTraceNet-Hier: hierarchical co-occurrence encoder and frozen score fusion
svg.desc: One 256 by 256 grayscale image yields three co-occurrence streams. Global histograms have 24 by 39 entries. Texture and cost streams retain 16 by 3 and 30 by 5 histograms of 169 words and share word-encoder weights. The new branch combines zone and family encodings and adds a full-descriptor linear skip. Source-validation alpha blends the new score and frozen dual-view reward score for a cover or stego decision.
svg.text: Tensor shapes are per image. Each route emits 22 features.
α is fixed on source validation.
